_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest). 1: one swap or code with small whole numbers that is easy to spot; 2: a swap that needs both sides worked out, the = sign moved, or several swaps tried; 3: putting in four signs, or a code with brackets or squares; 4: algebra, fractions, percentages, or a meaning swap applied to every option. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
